evidence.description: DateFormatter is instantiated within the localizedMonthAndYear computed property.

candidates.explanation: The DateFormatter is instantiated inside a computed property that is accessed frequently. DateFormatter is an expensive object to create and should be reused or cached.
candidates.title: Inefficient DateFormatter instantiation

candidates.explanation: Using 'GMT' or 'UTC' as a string abbreviation in TimeZone(abbreviation:) is discouraged as it can vary by locale and may result in nil if the abbreviation is not recognized.
candidates.title: Hardcoded TimeZone abbreviation

evidence.description: Data is decoded into a dictionary via JSONSerialization, then converted back to Data to be decoded by JSONDecoder.

candidates.explanation: The code converts raw Data to a JSON object via JSONSerialization, then converts that same object back into Data via JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject:) to decode it into a Swift struct.
candidates.title: Potential for redundant data conversion

candidates.explanation: The 'numberOfTreesFinanced' property uses Double, but the context suggests it represents a count of items, which should typically be an Integer type.
candidates.title: Use of Double for discrete counts
